perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The proved contribution is the unrestricted Sym3 iff classification, obtained by closing Tamano's mixed rank-two branch with the adjugate-translation and cone-monotonicity argument. Its statistical payoff is confined to an exact pivot and confidence set for a primitive denominator supported on at most three supplied directions; it establishes no inference result for the causal ratio itself. The package supplies no implemented recognizer, complexity analysis, or new worked causal certificate demonstrating that the unrestricted cases occur and matter beyond the cited front-door example. The dimension-free theorem handles only the positive-gradient corank-one branch, leaving generic rank at most d-2 entirely open, so it does not provide a general higher-dimensional classification framework. The framing avoids claiming that higher-dimensional converse or causal-ratio inference, although references to exhaustive half-trek auditing apply only under the stated rank-at-most-three compression restriction. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: cited-underspecified@lem:tamano-sym2-converse, cited-underspecified@lem:tamano-sym3-reduction, cited-underspecified@lem:tamano-ambient-compression
